\subsubsection*{Literal coefficients of the second ninth-root-field unit}
The following table defines the actual element used in A.199:
\[
 s=\frac1{1036253459504241}\sum_{h=0}^{53}A_h\,
       t^{\lfloor h/6\rfloor}z^{h\bmod6}.
\]
For each fixed $h$, concatenate its decimal blocks from left to right,
in the order of the displayed block numbers, then apply the displayed
sign. Leading zeroes in a block are part of its forty-digit position.
The final blank cell contributes no digit. This is an integer coefficient
definition, not a decimal approximation.
